articles.summary: AssemblyAI-TTS-1: natural speech for voice agents, streaming in 90 ms. Unlimited concurrency, no annual contract, $15 per 1M characters.
articles.title: Introducing AssemblyAI-TTS-1: text-to-speech built for voice agents

articles.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is live on AssemblyAI’s LLM Gateway. On the Voice Standard Bench it posts the top dictation score of 50+ models, but trails GPT-6 Luna on long transcripts at about 16× the cost per hour of audio.
articles.title: Gemini 4 Argon is now on LLM Gateway: here’s how it scores on voice tasks

articles.summary: Today we're releasing Universal-3 Pro, a first of its kind promptable speech language model. And we’re so confident you’ll be blown away by its performance that you can use the model free for all of February to see for yourself.
articles.title: Introducing Universal-3 Pro: A new class of speech language model optimized for Voice AI

articles.summary: We are thrilled to release the AssemblyAI C# .NET SDK. Use the SDK to transcribe audio asynchronously or in real-time, use our audio intelligence models, and apply LLMs to your audio data using LeMUR.
articles.title: Introducing the AssemblyAI C# .NET SDK

articles.summary: AssemblyAI's LLM Gateway now has 50+ models, scored on real transcripts across four voice tasks and four transcript lengths. Voice Standard Bench shows which models to use, with quality, speed, and cost on real transcripts, side by side.
articles.title: Introducing Voice Standard Bench: 50+ models, ranked by performance, speed and cost on real audio
